title: Markup assigned through panel.outerHTML = markup (javascript) — review required
description: The javascript assignment panel.outerHTML = markup replaces the element’s markup by serializing the string as HTML, so any interpolated value becomes live nodes. When the value is text, use textContent assignment. This lexical rule flags the assignment and leaves provenance to review.
remediation: Assign to textContent assignment for text, or sanitize the markup before the assignment.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the assignment; attacker control of the right-hand side is not proven.
